decisions.reason: Position 3.4.89.0 charges for travel to and from the site. The supply wording belongs to later numbered positions.
The position pays for bevel or fitting cuts in 300 mm panels. The allowance for cutting waste does not purchase a new product.
The position forms recesses at support brackets; it does not supply the brackets or any other product.
The position forms recesses at parapet posts or column extensions; it does not supply those components.
The position creates 50 mm round wall openings without supplying a product.
The position creates 100 mm round wall openings without supplying a product.
The position forms a dummy joint in aerated concrete wall panels; it supplies neither panels nor a joint product.
The surcharge covers bevel, miter, or fitting cuts in 250 mm panels, including cutting waste, not a new product.
The position creates 50 mm round slab openings without supplying a product.
The position creates 100 mm round slab openings without supplying a product.
The position creates 150 mm round slab openings without supplying a product.
The position creates 200 mm round slab openings without supplying a product.
The position creates rectangular slab openings up to 150 cm² without supplying a product.
The roof drains are supplied by others. This position covers installation and sealing only.
The position covers rectangular ceiling cutouts and associated reinforcement work without specifying a new component to supply.
The position covers round ceiling cutouts and associated reinforcement work without specifying a new component to supply.
The position forms screed recesses and finishes the screed around penetrations without specifying a new product.
The position forms screed recesses and finishes the screed around penetrations without specifying a new product.
The position forms screed recesses up to 0.10 m² and finishes around penetrations; no new product is specified.
The position forms screed recesses up to 2.5 m² and finishes around penetrations; no new product is specified.
The position forms a recess for an entrance mat to be installed by others; it does not supply the mat.
The surcharge covers only forming the recess for an entrance scraper grating supplied by others.
The entrance scraper grating is supplied by others, but the installation surcharge expressly includes new leveling mortar.
